test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To give someone the cold shoulder

options.text: To carry the burden of everyone
To be carried on someone’s back
To listen to someone with empathy

solution:
The correct answer is To ignore someone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom 'to give someone the cold shoulder' is 'to ignore someone'.
 
• To give someone the cold shoulder: Cold and unfriendly treatment from a person known to one.
 
 
• Example: After I got the promotion, a few of my co-workers started giving me the cold shoulder.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: To ignore someone.
